what.text: This page follows refugees from Cambodia living in Laos, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 1987, the last year with a figure, UNHCR counted 80 Cambodian refugees in Laos, 0.2% of all refugees from Cambodia that year.
Today, France hosts the most Cambodian refugees, followed by Thailand, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Cambodia from 1971 to 1975 and from 1978 to 1998, with the KR among the opponents.
The main year of displacement in the data, 1980, falls within the second period.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group runs from 1976, at 110 refugees, to 1987.
The figure was at its highest, 10370, at the end of 1980.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Laos.
These are year-end totals for Laos only, reported to UNHCR from 1976 to 1987.
